observation_statement: ∀ (s : State) (who amount callbackAmount : Nat), borrowAllowed s who amount → (borrowWithWithdrawal s who amount callbackAmount true).debt who ≤ (borrowWithWithdrawal s who amount callbackAmount true).collateral who / 2
proof:
by
  intro s who amount callbackAmount allowed
  unfold borrowWithWithdrawal
  rw [if_pos ⟨allowed, rfl⟩]
  by_cases hw : withdrawAllowed (borrowSimple s who amount true) who callbackAmount ∧ true = true
  · unfold withdraw
    rw [if_pos hw]
    show (borrowSimple s who amount true).debt who ≤ (put (borrowSimple s who amount true).collateral who ((borrowSimple s who amount true).collateral who - callbackAmount)) who / 2
    have hput : (put (borrowSimple s who amount true).collateral who ((borrowSimple s who amount true).collateral who - callbackAmount)) who = (borrowSimple s who amount true).collateral who - callbackAmount := by simp [put]
    rw [hput]
    exact hw.1.2.2
  · unfold withdraw
    rw [if_neg hw]
    unfold borrowSimple
    rw [if_pos ⟨allowed, rfl⟩]
    show (put s.debt who (s.debt who + amount)) who ≤ s.collateral who / 2
    have hput : (put s.debt who (s.debt who + amount)) who = s.debt who + amount := by simp [put]
    rw [hput]
    exact allowed.1
reasoning: Even when a borrow callback performs a withdrawal, debt stays at most half of collateral; the repaired withdraw guard enforces the ratio at withdrawal time.
